title: Replication Fidelity, Polymerase Proofreading and Mismatch Repair
method: Actual stored HTML teaching-prose paragraph text, whitespace-delimited; excludes headings, tables, SVG, captions, questions, explanations, references and UI. Article count includes headings, captions, tables, expanded answers and references; excludes SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.E.08 QA reports 14,663 teaching words; 2.E.07 reports 14,943. This node has 13,946 words in 134 distinct narrative paragraphs and 15 theory sections, including biochemical mechanisms, quantitative derivations and experimental inference.
scientific_checks: Separate editorial self-review of complementarity versus selection, two-metal catalysis, kinetic specificity and proofreading partition, polarity, Pol III subunits, Pol alpha exception, mismatch fixation and strand slippage, E. coli Dam/MutSLH/UvrD processing, alternative bacterial MMR, eukaryotic MutSα/β and MutLα, PCNA/RFC strand cues, EXO1 directionality and alternative processing, mutation spectra and pathway interactions. Checked the 1989 Lahue–Au–Modrich reconstitution and 2006 Kadyrov human MutLα study; Luria–Delbrück fluctuation interpretation. Recomputed 10^-10, 0.0004498988, 0.2591817793, 0.1812692469, -ln(0.4)=0.9162907319, hypothetical dataset sums 100 each, 0.8, 5×10^-5, 0.04, 100000-fold, 10.1 survivors, 1% unchanged. Original questions and schematic diagrams; hypothetical data clearly identified.
